scenes.text: Gemini now *builds and edits PDFs* right in the chat. *Free.*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 29: ask the Gemini app for a PDF, doc, slide deck or spreadsheet and it appears in the chat. Expand it to edit, or highlight a line and say what to change.
Every user, every language Gemini supports. PDFs work on your phone; docs, sheets and slides are web only.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Make a PDF once, sell it for months: a budgeting workbook, a meal-prep guide, a wedding checklist.
Prompt: 'Make a 12-page PDF meal-prep guide for college students on $50 a week, with a shopping list and a 7-day plan.' Sell it on Gumroad, Payhip or your own site.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Proofread every page and test any recipe or tip yourself first. Etsy now bans untested AI guides (more on that tomorrow).
Source: Google, Oct 29, 2026; Digital Trends, Oct 29, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Free with a Google account, in the Gemini app or on the web.
Paid Gemini plans only raise the daily limits. The free tier builds your first PDF today.

scenes.text: What PDF would you *sell first*? Comment it. *Save this* for the weekend.
